scientific.integrity: The exact printed AdaMod Algorithm 2 is specialized to a deterministic scalar strongly convex quadratic. Its source-started cap is retained at every step. An explicit rational invariant contraction proves the zero-decay theorem; a four-state contractive perturbation argument proves persistence for small strictly positive first and second moments.
limitations: Constant base learning rate; deterministic one-dimensional quadratic.
Explicit smoothing parameter interval excludes the common paper defaults near one.
Positive-moment robustness is existence of a small open parameter neighborhood, not a numerical radius.
Positive moment parameters yield an asymptotic, not finite-time exact, two-cycle.

title: Source-initialized AdaMod converges to a nonminimizing two-cycle after initial descent
